Specification: This module specifies a ring buffer abstraction with a fixed number of slots indexed modulo the buffer size. Each slot stores either a value from Values or the distinguished NULL value, and the module additionally tracks the sets of readers and writers currently accessing each slot in order to model multi-step reads and writes. The specification provides initialization, index computation, begin/end read and write actions, and invariants such as type correctness and absence of data races; comments explicitly state that client specifications using this module should include NoDataRaces as an invariant.
RecordConstructor:
[
    slots   |-> [i \in 0 .. LastIndex |-> NULL ],
    readers |-> [i \in 0 .. LastIndex |-> {}   ],
    writers |-> [i \in 0 .. LastIndex |-> {}   ]
  ]
